our_title: Local failures before the first collective of SCOTCH_dgraphOrderComputeList hang the other processes
ran: scans/basefi_np3_r*.txt and scans/buildfi_np3_r*.txt (orderfi, np 3, default strategy, mode user): every allocation #1-#56 of any rank (contextThreadInit2/threadContextInit of CONTEXTINIT, yyalloc/yyrealloc/yyparse of the default strategy build SCOTCH_stratDgraphOrderBuild) -> the failing rank prints e.g. "(0): ERROR: stratParserParse: out of memory (5)" / "SCOTCH_stratDgraphOrder: error in ordering strategy", returns 1, and the other ranks never return (HANG, 15 s timeout) on both trees. Also read: the memAlloc of vnumloctab at library_dgraph_order.c:294-297 ("goto fail" while the other processes enter dorderNew/MPI_Scan).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/library_dgraph_order.c:190-193, :210-213, :294-297 (and the same pattern in the other PT-Scotch API routines that build a default strategy or allocate before their first collective, e.g. library_dgraph_map.c:173-186)

fix_options.label: A: agree on the local status once before the first collective of the API routine
fix_options.summary: cheklocval after the context/strategy/allocation steps, MPI_Allreduce MAX on srcgrafptr->proccomm before dorderFrst (which is collective), return 1 everywhere on failure.
fix_options.tested: untested: design only; library_dgraph_order.c is outside this group (G23/API groups)
fix_options.tradeoffs: one small collective per API call
fix_options.maintainer_fit: same policy as the unconditional agreements of this series

fix_options.label: B: document that API-level allocation failures are fatal for the job

our_title: dgmap cannot read a centralized target architecture file with more than one process
ran: LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$WORK/build/lib mpirun --oversubscribe -np 2 $WORK/build/bin/dgmap $WORK/scotch/src/check/data/m16x16.grf $INFRA/asan/tgt/h3.tgt /dev/null -> "dgmap(1): ERROR: main: target architecture file not provided" (rank 1), job aborted; the same with a cmplt target file ($C/sub.tgt or any file); np 1 works (and then fails in kdgraphMapRbMap for non-complete targets, DMO-17). dgpart (no target file) works at any np.
read_only: src/scotch/dgmap.c:361-379 and src/libscotch/common_file.c fileBlockOpenDist (centralized streams are removed on non-root processes, then dgmap requires C_filepntrtgtinp on every process)
location_7_0_17: src/scotch/dgmap.c:376-379; src/check/Makefile (no check_prog_dgmap target, only check_prog_dgpart)
evidence:
dgmap.c:377-378: "if (C_filepntrtgtinp == NULL)
      errorPrint ("main: target architecture file not provided");"; common_file.c fileBlockOpenDist: "if (proclocnum != protglbnum) {             /* If not root process   */
        filetab[i].nameptr = NULL;                /* Remove stream         */
        filetab[i].fileptr = NULL;"

fix_options.label: A: load the target architecture on the root and broadcast it (SCOTCH_archLoad on root, serialize/broadcast), or let every process open the target file (mark the target stream as not centralized)
fix_options.summary: the simplest correct behaviour for a small text file is to open it on every process: in dgmap.c, open the target file independently of fileBlockOpenDist (every process has the file name) and load it everywhere.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: dgord opens its centralized output only on the root the same way; the maintainer should decide the intended semantics

fix_options.label: B: add check_prog_dgmap to src/check/Makefile and CMakeLists.txt so that the tool is exercised
fix_options.summary: a dgmap run on a cmplt target file at np 3

our_title: dorderSave waits forever on an incomplete distributed ordering
ran: With this series, after an agreed failure of SCOTCH_dgraphOrderCompute() (rc=1 on every rank): $C/one.sh $WORK/buildfi/lib $C/bin_buildfi/orderfi 3 0 76 all -> SCOTCH_dgraphOrderPerm() rc=0 on every rank (identity permutation: the ordering holds no leaf), then SCOTCH_dgraphOrderSave() never returns (HANG): the root broadcasts the index of the missing fragment and waits in MPI_Recv for a process that does not exist. Reachable only when a user ignores the failure status (the review's DMO-06 scenario).
read_only: src/libscotch/dorder_io.c dorderSave: the fragment search loop "for (vertnum = 0; vertnum < ordeptr->vnodglbnbr; )" has no termination when no process holds the fragment; dorderPerm, by contrast, first reduces the fragment sizes and returns "invalid parameters (2)" when they do not sum to vertglbnbr (dorder_perm.c:115-119)
evidence: dorder_io.c: "if (linkptr == &ordeptr->linkdat) {         /* If fragment not found locally */ ... MPI_Bcast (&vertnum, ...) ... MPI_Recv (peritab + vertnum, ordeptr->vnodglbnbr - vertnum, GNUM_MPI, MPI_ANY_SOURCE, DORDERTAGPERI, ...)"

fix_options.label: A: reduce the fragment sizes first, as dorderPerm does, and fail collectively when they do not cover vnodglbnbr
fix_options.summary: MPI_Allreduce SUM of the local leaf vnodlocnbr before the collection loop; errorPrint "dorderSave: incomplete ordering"; return 1 on every process.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: dorderPerm already has exactly this check (dorder_perm.c:115-119)

fix_options.label: B: leave as is (an ordering whose computation failed must not be saved)
fix_options.maintainer_fit: the symmetric routine dorderPerm checks, so should dorderSave

our_title: Leaf failures of parallel recursive bipartitioning were not agreed upon: other processes hung in dmapTerm

Patched (patches/0008): rc=1 on every rank, 0 live blocks on every rank ($C/targeted_map2.txt). Same with the MPI_Init_thread drivers ($C/reverify_thread.txt).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/kdgraph_map_rb_part.c:445 (kdgraphMapRbPart returns kdgraphMapRbPart2 without agreement); leaves run kdgraphMapRbPartSequ on single processes and kdgraphMapRbAddPart/AddBoth/AddOne locally
evidence:
kdgraph_map_rb_part.c:445: "return (kdgraphMapRbPart2 (&grafdat, &datadat)); /* Perform DRB */"; library_dgraph_map.c:190-193: "if (((o = kdgraphMapSt (&mapgrafdat, &mapmappdat, mapstraptr)) == 0) && /* Perform mapping */
